outline:
本課程介紹自適應訊號處理的基本理論與應用，涵蓋維納濾波、最小均方（LMS）演算法、遞迴最小均方（RLS）演算法及仿射投影演算法（APA）。課程將探討自適應濾波器的收斂性、穩定性與效能分析，並透過 MATLAB 模擬與實作，讓學生理解其在噪聲消除、通道均衡、回音消除等領域的實際應用。此外，學生將研讀相關研究論文，培養分析與應用自適應演算法的能力，並透過期末專題整合所學內容，解決實際工程問題。

This course introduces the fundamental theories and applications of adaptive signal processing, covering Wiener filtering, Least Mean Squares (LMS) algorithms, Recursive Least Squares (RLS) algorithms, and the Affine Projection Algorithm (APA). It explores the convergence, stability, and performance analysis of adaptive filters. Through MATLAB simulations and implementations, students will gain hands-on experience in applying these techniques to noise cancellation, channel equalization, and echo cancellation. Additionally, students will study relevant research papers to develop analytical and practical skills in adaptive algorithms. The course culminates in a final project, where students integrate their knowledge to solve real-world engineering problems.
